fields.label: Party type
fields.description: Customer: tax a customer withheld from you (a credit). Supplier: tax you withheld from a supplier (you remit it). Income received: tax withheld at source from your dividend, interest, rent or royalty (a credit). Payment made: tax you withheld from a dividend, interest, rent, fee or other payment to someone who is not a supplier (you remit it).

fields.label: Counter account
fields.description: For Income received / Payment made: the account on the other side of the tax (for example dividend income, or dividends payable).

fields.label: Invoice
fields.description: Sales Invoice (customer) or Purchase Invoice (supplier) this tax relates to. The invoice is settled by the tax amount.

fields.label: Tax rule code
fields.description: Code of an approved WHT Tax Rule. The rate is taken from it.

fields.label: Tax withheld
fields.description: Leave blank to calculate from the rule; enter the certificate amount to override.

fields.label: Tax account
fields.description: Customer lines: a WHT credit (asset) account. Supplier lines: a WHT payable (liability) account. Defaults from the rule.
